meta.name: senpi-qa
meta.description: QA the omo Senpi adapter (packages/omo-senpi, packages/senpi-task) against the REAL senpi binary in strict isolation, and write every artifact to the one canonical evidence path .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/. The live drivers under packages/omo-senpi/scripts/qa/ create their own isolated SENPI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and ignore the caller's, so the real ~/.senpi/agent is never written. Ships scripts/resolve-evidence-dir.mjs, which is the ONLY sanctioned way to pick an evidence directory: it rejects traversal, separators, absolute paths, and stray roots such as local-ignore/qa-evidence. Use whenever someone changes anything under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, the task/team engine, the DAG, task RPC, or skill delivery. Triggers: senpi qa, qa senpi, senpi-qa, test senpi adapter, verify senpi task, senpi task e2e, senpi team e2e, task dag qa, live senpi driver, senpi evidence path.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试 Senpi 适配器隔离运行，确保不污染真实环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改动过 Senpi 适配器代码，想要隔离验证却不想碰真实数据。
copy.tagline_en: Test the Senpi adapter in isolation without touching your real environment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the Senpi adapter and need isolated QA without touching real data.

howto.what: 用真实 senpi 二进制在隔离环境中跑 QA 脚本，检验 omo-senpi 适配器和任务引擎，把全部产物写入 .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/，并附 README。不触碰真实 ~/.senpi/agent；senpi 缺失时报告 SKIP/FAIL，不当作通过。
howto.when: 当你改动 packages/omo-senpi 或 packages/senpi-task 下的代码，或要求对 Senpi 适配器、任务引擎等做 QA、验证或调试时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一下 senpi-qa，检查适配器是否正常。
say.note: 会运行 QA 驱动并保存证据目录。

say.text: 对 senpi 任务引擎做一次端到端验证。
say.note: 会启动真实 senpi 进程，测试任务整个流程。

say.text: 跑 senpi-qa 的快速自检。
say.note: 会先验证驱动和隔离环境本身可用。

howto.what_en: Uses the real senpi binary in an isolated env to run QA drivers, exercising the adapter and task engine. Writes every artifact to exactly .omo/evidence/omo-senpi-adapter/<slug>/ with a README. Leaves ~/.senpi/agent untouched; reports SKIP/FAIL when senpi is absent.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you change code under packages/omo-senpi or packages/senpi-task, or ask to QA, verify, or debug the Senpi adapter, task engine, and similar.

say_en.text: Run senpi-qa for me and check if the adapter is OK.
say_en.note: This runs the QA driver and stores evidence.

say_en.text: Do an end-to-end validation of the Senpi task engine.
say_en.note: Starts a real senpi process and exercises the task lifecycle.
Checks that the harness and isolation work first.
